snippet.title: The Coma 3: Bloodlines | Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
The Coma 3: Bloodlines is launching on April 30th!

Enter the nightmare once more with The Coma 3: Bloodlines. This 2D run-and-hide adventure thrusts you into the shadowy realm of The Coma, where three characters are drawn into a web of cursed history, supernatural wraiths, and the dark secrets of Sehwa High School.

Experience South Korea’s unique blend of folklore, sorcery, and urban legends as you explore new locations, evade relentless puppets and monsters, and uncover the truth behind Sehwa’s bloodlines. Survival means running, hiding, and solving mysteries, because in The Coma, there is no fighting back.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3885590/The_Coma_3_Bloodlines/
